lines.text: 1boy, Xia Yizhou, 3D game character, sharp angular face, narrow and deep purple eyes, bright purple pupils, thin upper eyelid, long eyelashes, dark brown messy layered short hair, asymmetrical side bangs, hair falling over forehead, thin sharp eyebrows, straight delicate nose, thin pale lips, slight calm smile, fair smooth skin, defined jawline, small silver flame-shaped earring on left ear, focus on facial features, strictly preserve facial structure and hairstyle, masterpiece, best quality, cinematic lighting, facial consistency

lines.name: 夏以昼
lines.text: [發送了一張圖片]

lines.name: 妍妍
lines.text: 再发一张，调整一下眼睛大一点，圆一点，脸型细长一点

note: 非要折腾着让人按她的要求重拍，拍完又不说话了……这小祖宗到底想干嘛？
